tasks.name: Morning Draft Sweep
tasks.prompt:
Good morning! Scan the connected sources for messages that need a reply:
1. Email — threads awaiting a response
2. LinkedIn — unread messages and comments on my posts
3. X — direct messages and mentions worth replying to

For each one that genuinely needs a reply, create a draft in Draft Desk in my voice (capture the recipient and the real recent thread messages). Skip anything already queued. Do not send anything — every reply waits for my approval.
